newSourceFindings.meaning: May locate a previously downloaded file by path/hash, but the model is generic transport bookkeeping. It supplies neither a descriptive ECU name nor an ECU/child route join. A declared fileVersion is not proof that the shown writer populates it or that it is the installed ECU code.

newSourceFindings.meaning: A filename may embed a complete target code, but its prefix is not universally a CAN address and filename text is not an explicit descriptive component name. Without original applicable strategy/component manifest it cannot choose INS/FRL/switch subroles.

newSourceFindings.meaning: The earlier whole-response privacy projection still cannot prove upstream field absence. The typed in-app model and its existing version/result projections do not retain a new descriptive field. No original server response or disk cache was recovered.

alreadyClosedPathsNotRepeated.basis: Earlier stock-cache-followup and ecu-role-binding reports already trace the conditional write and six-field installed-version projection. No new descriptive schema was found here.
